name: Pro Bulk Edit and Merge
description: Dedupe and merge CRM records: duplicate groups via union-find match rules, side-by-side compare of 2-4 records with a winner per field, conflict highlighting with word diff, a validated merged-record form, merge audit summary, plus virtualised bulk field updates with diff preview and immer-patch undo/redo.

props.name: fields
props.description: { key, label, type?: text|longtext|email|phone|url|number|date|tags, required?, options?, bulkEditable? }

props.name: records / defaultRecords
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled: { id, values, updatedAt, createdAt?, source? }

props.name: onRecordsChange
props.description: Next records after merge, bulk update, undo or redo

props.name: titleKey
props.description: Field used as each record's display name

props.name: listColumns
props.description: Extra columns in the bulk-edit list

props.name: matchRules
props.description: Duplicate match keys; default same email and same phone

props.name: duplicateGroups
props.description: Precomputed groups from your dedupe service

props.name: onMerge
props.description: Persist a merge (survivor, removedIds, audit); reject to keep records

props.name: onBulkUpdate
props.description: Called after a bulk update is applied

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Disable merging, bulk updates and undo

usage: Each field row is a radio group: Left/Right picks a source, Up/Down moves between fields. Typing in the merged column marks the field as a custom edit. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z redoes merges and bulk updates.
